steps.text: What's going on here, Sommer?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: I dunno either! I was just driving my truck when the engine blew a gasket, then I noticed this kid lying down by the road. Scared the hell out of me! Thought I hit her.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: She fainted out in the wilds on her lonesome, kept saying she was looking for someone in a red hoodie.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: I couldn't just leave her out there, so I brought her back here...
Looking for me? I've got no idea who she is, though.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Seems like an unlucky loner to me. Think we can let her stay in our camp? Considering how busy we've been lately, having another pair of hands would be nice.
You know every member of the association has to go through a strict background check, Sommer.
An Infecte—person of unknown origin like her... What if she has something to do with the famiglie?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: *sigh*...
The doctor said her condition's stable, so once she's up, send her on her way.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: A-Alright then.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: This ragazza sfortunata sure is holding that knife of hers real tight. Someone might get hurt. Let's get that off her—

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Don't touch me!

steps.name: Woman Wearing A Red Hoodie
steps.text: You're awake.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You—!
Lyudmila looks at the woman standing in front of her, and gives her bleary eyes a good knead or two.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Sorry... Where am I?

steps.name: Woman Wearing A Red Hoodie
steps.text: Nuova Volsinii's Truckers' Union.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Oh, so you saved me... Thanks.

steps.name: Woman Wearing A Red Hoodie
steps.text: Don't mention it. Our members aren't the type to leave an unconscious girl to fend for herself in the wilds. But now that you're awake, we can't help you much further than that.

steps.name: Woman Wearing A Red Hoodie
steps.text: We'll give you something to eat, but you'll have to go after you're done. See her fed, Sommer.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Thanks for the help. I'll be going, then.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: No need to rush, youngster.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: I wanted to ask you something, just to be safe... You're not with a famiglia, are you?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: ...It's been many, many years since I last heard that word.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Figured. You don't look like the sort who would have anything to do with them.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Don't worry about it too much, Eirene's just real worried about wise guys getting their claws into the association. She's got a lot on her mind, so it's not like she has it out for you specifically.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: She was the one who paid for the doctor to give you a checkup when I brought you back here, even.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Thanks. I get it, I'm not going to cause you guys trouble.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I just need some time to think... about what I should do next.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Know how to drive?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I've driven a truck in Ursus. Does that count?
A quiet whisper, and at the same time, an equally-gentle caress.
Like leaves gently falling on grass, the wind that reaches the leeward slopes of the wilds is free of danger.
Once, surrounded by whispers and caresses like this, she slept. She grew.
On Rhodes Island, none dared treat her this way. None could treat her this way, not even Kal'tsit.

spans.text: On Rhodes Island, none dared treat her this way. None
treat her this way, not even Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: ...Grandma?!

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Can't you see clearly anymore, Grandma?

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: Like I told you before, my eyes were devoured by wolves. These glasses are just for show.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: Only once their eyes are gouged out and placed back into Grandma's sockets can I see you again, Red.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Can't you give me a hug, Grandma?

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: My arms were swallowed whole by wolves. You must chop off their limbs and bring them to Grandma so I can hug you again.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Can't you teach me how to sing again, Grandma?

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: I do wish to continue teaching you, but the wolves are always howling, and I dare not startle them.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Why did you take so long to find me, Grandma?

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: There are simply too many wolves, Red. They are hiding themselves along the side of the road. You must cut off their hides and make Grandma some clothes with them.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Are you really going to disappear, Grandma?

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: That depends on if you can help Grandma, my sweet child.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I... I found a wolf in Lungmen, a fake one. But she had the smell of a true wolf on her.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I haven't found anything new since then...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Well, actually, I haven't been looking, Grandma.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: Oh, I don't blame you, Red. You're the most well-behaved, kindest child in all the land.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I'm not. I passed out on my first wolf hunt. I was too weak. Kal'tsit found me in the grass and saved me.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: When I was with her, she told me about a lot of things I didn't know about.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: What is 'protection'? What is 'murder'? What is 'suffering'? What is 'happiness'? What can I learn? What can I do?

spans.text: What is 'protection'? What is 'murder'? What is 'suffering'? What is 'happiness'? What can I

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: There's a lot of questions, and they're all really hard. I don't get them.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: 'Suffering'? 'Happiness'?

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: It's all because I didn't take good care of you. On the contrary, it's me who needs your help...

spans.text: It's all because I didn't take good care of you. On the contrary, it's

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: If you are unhappy, child, you can stay on Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: I don't have much time left. You can forget Grandma, forget your life as a wolf hunter...
Red opens her eyes.
The windows and door to her room are shut tight. Not even a wisp of wind can find its way inside.
This is the third time this night she has awoken to the same dream.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma needs me...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: (Wiggles ears forcefully)

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I promised Kal'tsit. If I want to leave Rhodes Island, I need to tell her.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: But Kal'tsit's not here. She went to a place called Tremons or something. A city far, far away.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I should wait—No, I can't wait. Grandma can't wait.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: (Sniffs in alarm)

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I smell a wolf.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Not many true wolves left. They're here.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Hurting Grandma is just a 'game' to them.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: And the rules of my game says I should kill them.

spans.text: game says I should kill them.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: ...Grandma is still waiting for me.

steps.name: Carnevale Participant A
steps.text: 'For this extraordinary night, I sharpen my claws!'

steps.name: Carnevale Participant B
steps.text: 'For a swift hunt, I bare my fangs!'

steps.name: Carnevale Participant A
steps.text: 'For unrestrained festivities, I fight to the very last!'

steps.name: Carnevale Participant B
steps.text: 'Only when the last one of us stands can the game reach its end!'

steps.name: Carnevale Participant A
steps.text: 'Why are we this way?'

steps.name: Carnevale Participant A & B
steps.text: 'Because we are wolves!'

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: The acting is pretty meh, but it's always nice to support street art! Check out these lights, n' the decor! And those tunes—

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Emperor? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hey, you here too, ain't you, wolf pup?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: A party like this needs a genius artist like me! No shit I'm here!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Take a good look, Agnese, these kids know a party way better than you.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Did you come here for the party or for Agnese?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Agnese might've taught you a lot, kid, but did she never tell you a party's a good place to see old friends?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Emperor here with that hyper-killer stare♪ Friends list full at one hundred no matter where♪ ...Grab a gun, shoot you dead, he don't care♪ Whad'dya think?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You're just singing random words...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Improvisation! It's called improv, girl! Agnese, don't tell me you didn't teach your kid what kinda music the people crave!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Don't bad-mouth her! Agnese's amazing, she taught me way nicer songs than yours!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Oh yeah? What else does she teach you?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Lots of things! How to light a fire, how to find places to sleep, how to hold a bow, how to use a knife, how to hunt and how to bleed my prey afterwards!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yeesh, what's with all the fightin' and killin'...?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: She also taught me about which way the wind blows, what flowers smell like, how to talk to tuskbeasts.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: She taught me how to talk to humans, and how to live with them.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Y'know, you might just have the gift of the gab there, unlike that red one. She says half a word n' folks is already on edge.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Agnese also told me that the humans' carnival is lots of fun, and how I can be happy and free in the city, just like out in the wilds...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Sounds like she taught you a lot. You lucky. The other Fangs don't got a chance to learn all that.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: The other Fangs...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I met the rest of the pack n' their Fangs. You listen to one word coming out they mouths n' you lose it.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: *sigh* Tell you the truth, Agnese, if it wasn't for all this urgent business, I wouldn't wanna have nothin' to do with you 'Signori dei Lupi' or whatever you call yourselves.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I know, I know, that wolf pack's a bunch of stubborn, savage losers, but there ain't no gettin' out of this family reunion for the two of you.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Agnese's family...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: 'My will is not enough to avert the entire pack's gaze...' The hell you talkin' about, Agnese? What happened to all that 'breaking free from this road' n' 'starting a new life'?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: 'The game is the collective decision of the pack. Before it ends, we cannot be distracted by other matters. This is our nature...' Why're we back at that boring-ass game of yours?!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: 'To go against our nature is an endless climb...' Talk about a pain in the ass! Seriously, I don't wanna talk to y'all ever again. I try n' have a normal conversation, but you always gotta bring it back to 'nature' or whatever.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Agnese said 'this game must have a winner'.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You dumbass mangy mutt, I take back everything good I ever said about you!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Forget it. You taught this kid so much about the outside world. Don't tell me you still thinkin' about sendin' her into a deathmatch with the other Fangs? You didn't ask me to get her to Rhodes Island just so she could die today, did you?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: If you so worried about keepin' her safe, then get her ass back to Rhodes already. Sheesh, y'all keep runnin' around for no good reason!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Whoa! When the hell did these tuskbeasts come? Who're you tryna scare, flashin' your grills like that?!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: They're scared. They can smell the Fangs.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I smell them too.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: The wolves are here.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Hey, what the—! What's the big idea, shoving that freezing can of salt soda in my face?! Scared the crap outta me!

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: You get way too into Lyudmila's stories.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: So, what happened next?

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: This Talulah lady, did Crownslayer manage to kill her in the end?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: No. Crownslayer didn't kill her.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: Shame. Imagine staying by Talulah's side the entire time but never realizing your so-called leader was an evil dragon spewing lies... A lot of lives could've been saved.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: Say, if this Crownslayer didn't kill Talulah or the Emperor of Ursus, why take that name?

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Easy for you to say. We're talking about an emperor and an evil dragon here. You ever killed anyone, Romi?

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Wait, you couldn't have, could you? I mean, when you worked for the Borgias...

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: I've never done any of the sort.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: I was just their night driver. They're not gonna ask a guy like me to kill someone.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Considering how crappy your driving is, would the dons really have picked you to drive them around at night?

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Night driving... This some sort of famiglia lingo I don't know?

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: It means exactly what it sounds like, driving at night! You're talking like a police officer! I'm tellin' ya, it's all in the past now.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Now that you mention it, Romi, you've been getting more tickets than usual lately.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: It's Carnevale. The whole city's packed full of both people and cars. You know that, man.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: And just so you know, I used to drive around a nomadic city full of ruins while trying to hide from a Catastrophe!

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Still stuck in one of Lyudmila's stories, huh?

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Speaking of, those stories are just ones you heard while in Ursus, right? You go into so much detail, it's almost like they were actually about you...

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Look at you guys, drinking the soda she bought you, listening to her stories, and now bothering her with questions. Didn't your mom ever teach you manners?

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Got me there, Sommer. Sorry, Lyudmila.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: It's fine.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: You know you don't need to treat us every week, right?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: How long has it been since you came to our camp? Three months? Four?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Not too sure myself, but it's been a while now.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: We pay you a wage, but you always end up giving it all back to us. Why not listen to my advice, save some for the future so you can start a business?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You've all got families to feed. Me? I'm flying solo. Don't have anything else to spend that money on anyway. Besides, I'm one ragazza sfortunata. Even if I save it all, it's likely to sprout wings and fly away.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Oh, don't be like that...

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Look, it's just two crates of salt soda.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I actually wanted to treat you guys to some beer for the weekend.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: But since you guys will be busy with that film shoot at Court Square tonight, you'll just have to make do with soda.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: If you're still thirsty, feel free to take more.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: I'll have a couple more, then!

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Here. Not gonna try one yourself, considering you're the one that bought them?

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Oh, didn't realize you haven't had one yet...

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: Just how many bottles are you trying to have, man?!

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Alright, I'm sorry, I'm sorry!

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: ...I'm good.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Look, everyone knows, Lyudmila.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Though I wouldn't say we don't completely mind. To tell you the truth, when I took off your mask... It scared the hell out of me.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: We just understand that... as an Infected, you're probably more worried than us about it spreading around.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Don't blame Romi and the others for pestering you with questions. They don't mean anything bad about it. They just want to get to know you a little better.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Don't be a stranger, Lyudmila.

The setting sun dyes the grass of the camp and the drivers' faces a deep red. Sommer leans against the back of his truck, stretching his hand out to her. The other drivers look at her, nary a hint of wariness on their smiling faces.
Can you get drunk off salt soda? The Reproba wonders as she furrows her brow.
After a short moment of silence, she lowers her mask and takes the proffered bottled of soda from him.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Alright, it's nearly showtime. Time to pack things up and drive over to Court Square.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Eirene was real clear about how strict the filming schedule is, even stricter than our dispatch timetables. We can't be late, or we'll be causing City Hall a whole lot of trouble.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: What about Eirene herself?

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Said she wanted to go talk with Judge Lavinia about qualification audits for new drivers.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: Oh yeah, Sommer, you're really not coming along?

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: It's easy, you just need to drive your truck and follow along, make a big scene. City Hall's even paying us more than a day's wage to do it.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: I-I've been driving a little too much lately. Now that I've finally got some spare time, I wanted to catch up on some Zs.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: How 'bout you, Lyudmila?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I've got something to take care of, so I'll be hanging back too.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Suit yourself. We'll be off then.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: *phew* Finally...
Once the convoy of trucks has left and night slowly washes over the camp, Sommer, all on his lonesome, goes to his own truck.
He starts the engine, but before he even closed the door, a figure was already sat in the passenger seat, seat belt fastened and all.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: L-Lyudmila...

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Thought you were going to catch some Zs?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Not much of a night drive with an empty passenger seat, yeah?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Lyudmila, I really...

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: What was it you said again? Don't be a stranger, Sommer.
